Conley & Stephenson Law Group
Baytown, TX

Settlement Demand
September 26, 2024
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1320 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
Our office represents Victor Gibson in connection with the side-impact collision that
occurred at a signalized intersection on June 4, 2024. Our client was prcoeeding
through the intersection on a green light when your insured's vehicle entered from a
cross street and struck the driver's side of our client's car. The force of the impact
spun the vehicle and caused the driver's head to strike the side window and airbag
housing.
As a direct result of the collision, our client was diagnosed with a concussion.
Symptoms have included persistent headaches, light sensitivity, dizziness, and
difficulty concentrating, and our client has been unable to work full duty while
recovering. Treating physicians have recommended ongoing neurological follow-up and a
graduated return to daily activities.
The liability picture is straightforward. Your insured had a duty to yield the right of
way and failed to do so, and the physical evidence and independent witness statements
support our client's account of the events. There is no reasonable basis to attribute
fault to our client.
Accordingly, we demand payment of $206,000.00 to resolve all claims arising from this
collision. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If
we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we are authorized to file
suit without further notice.
Expert review: Kendra Galloway, neurologist
Sincerely,
Colleen Orr
Conley & Stephenson Law Group
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
